# Teach My Audience

Posts that teach something real from your field, built on your insight bank.

Use when they want posts that teach, share expertise, give value, explain how something works in their field, or ask what they could teach. Not for general post ideas without a teaching angle (daily-post-ideas) or for rewriting their text.

**The user might say:** "Help me write posts that teach my audience something specific from my field. Show me the knowledge I can share and draft posts from the ones I pick."

## Steps

1. Their knowledge areas and freshest insight cards.
   ```sh
   xholic insights bank
   ```
2. Let them pick an area, then load its cards.
   ```sh
   xholic insights bank --area-id <area id>
   ```
3. Let them pick cards; write one teaching post per card yourself, citing only the card's evidence.
4. Check each draft.
   ```sh
   xholic drafts check --text "<post>"
   ```
5. Only when the user says so: save it as a draft (`xholic drafts save --text ...`) or schedule it (`xholic posts schedule --text ... --scheduled-at 2026-11-03T09:00 --timezone <their tz> --idempotency-key <unique>`). A draft is not a post.
